status: linear stationary-source and weak-field observable audit of the claim-1622 critical 0-minus PGT class

linearSourceSplit.metricEquation: in harmonic gauge, box bar(h)_{mu nu}=-16 pi G T_{mu nu}
linearSourceSplit.torsionAction: L_0minus=(A/2)S_mu S^mu+(B/2)(partial_mu S^mu)^2+S_mu J_c^mu, with A>0 and B>0
linearSourceSplit.diagonalization: around torsionless Minkowski the parity-even critical class has no linear h--0-minus mixing; T_mu_nu excites the 2-plus metric block and J_c excites the 0-minus connection block
linearSourceSplit.orbitalRule: orbital angular momentum is contained in T_0i and sources h_0i; Poincare-gauge torsion couples to intrinsic spin current, not orbital angular momentum
linearSourceSplit.unpolarizedRule: for an unpolarized macroscopic source the coarse-grained axial current vanishes even when T_0i and orbital angular momentum are nonzero

metricWeakField.gravitomagneticField: h_0i=-2G (J_orb cross r)_i/r^3, up to the stated metric-sign convention
metricWeakField.treeDecision: the b3 pseudoscalar-curvature square vanishes in the torsionless metric block and the unpolarized source has J_c=0, so the GR gravitoelectric and gravitomagnetic coefficients are unchanged at linear tree level

torsionExchange.contact: the P_T/A part is algebraic and contributes only an unresolved local axial-axial operator
torsionExchange.pointSpinPotential: V=f_1 f_2 sigma_1^i sigma_2^j partial_i partial_j Y_m(r)
torsionExchange.selectionRule: the separated pole force is dipole-dipole and averages to zero if either body has zero net intrinsic polarization; there is no minimal monopole-dipole force
torsionExchange.range: lambda_phi=hbar*c/m_phi; the tail is exponentially suppressed for r/lambda_phi much greater than one

gravityProbeB.interpretation: agreement tests the metric 2-plus frame-dragging sector; an ordinary unpolarized quartz gyroscope is not a direct torsion-spin source or detector

laboratoryRange.decision: a ten-centimetre polarized-spin experiment requires a mediator at or below about two micro-eV for an unsuppressed tail

naturalCriticalPoint.decision: the natural Planck-mass pole has exactly zero numerical long-range relevance; exp(-mr) is beyond negligible

higherOrderQualification.torsionStress: the energy of a sourced torsion configuration can backreact on the metric at quadratic order in intrinsic spin, but it neither renormalizes the universal linear Lense-Thirring coefficient nor survives for an unpolarized source
higherOrderQualification.finiteSize: a macroscopic polarized source requires convolution of the tensor Yukawa kernel with its spin density and material-specific spin fractions
higherOrderQualification.adS: over a local apparatus or Solar-System patch with r much less than ell_AdS, curvature corrections are O(r^2/ell_AdS^2); the source-selection conclusion is unchanged

falsifiability.genericSignal: an orientation-dependent finite-range spin-spin torque with the pseudoscalar tensor angular pattern and exponential range, absent for unpolarized source or detector
falsifiability.notUniqueYet: this force is shared by generic pseudoscalar and propagating-torsion EFTs
falsifiability.spin23FingerprintCondition: uniqueness requires the broken parent to fix flavor-dependent c_f, A and B, hence both the range and the correlated strengths f_f*m_phi=c_f/sqrt(B), while retaining an exactly GR Lense-Thirring coefficient for unpolarized rotation
falsifiability.decisivePattern: a non-GR unpolarized frame-dragging coefficient would falsify this isolated critical 0-minus action rather than confirm it

stopRules: DO NOT use LAGEOS or Gravity Probe B orbital/frame-dragging agreement as a direct bound on the isolated 0-minus torsion pole
DO NOT identify macroscopic rotation with the intrinsic axial current
SET the tree-level unpolarized Lense-Thirring correction to zero in the critical class, not merely to a small fitted value
USE polarized source and detector spin densities when applying the Yukawa potential
INCLUDE exp(-m r) before quoting any satellite or laboratory sensitivity
RECOMPUTE if another spin-parity sector, nonminimal matter coupling, parity violation, or selector dynamics is added
decision: The critical 0-minus class passes the Lense-Thirring gate by prediction rather than adjustment: its unpolarized weak-field metric is GR at linear tree level. Its only leading separated-body deviation is a polarized pseudoscalar Yukawa spin-spin force, naturally Planck range and generic unless the Spin(2,3) descendant fixes its coupling pattern.
